title: Testing Blog Development and Automation
excerpt: This is a test blog post used to verify the automated build process and sitemap generation.
author: Antigravity

content.introduction: This post exists solely for verification of the Whitezebra blog engine and automated deployment pipelines.

sections.heading: Verification Step 1: HTML Generation
sections.content: The build script should identify this JSON file and generate a corresponding HTML file in the /src directory.

sections.heading: Verification Step 2: Sitemap Integration
sections.content: The sitemap.xml should now automatically include this new URL with the correct domain and priority.

content.conclusion: If you can see this page and it appears in the sitemap, the development test was successful.
